name: extract-design
title_zh: 扒下一个网站的全套设计语言，八种格式一次给全
tagline_zh: 看到喜欢的站，别再截图猜色号、翻源码找字体了。给它一个 URL，拿回 AI 能读的 markdown。
tagline_en: Stop screenshotting sites to guess colors and fonts. Give it a URL, get AI-ready markdown, an HTML preview, plus.
desc_en: Extract the full design language from any website URL. Produces 8 output files including AI-optimized markdown, visual HTML preview, Tailwind config, React theme, shadcn/ui theme, Figma variables, W3C design tokens, and CSS variables. Also runs WCAG accessibility scoring. Use when user says 'extract design', 'get design system', 'design language', 'design tokens', 'what colors/fonts does this site
why_zh: 八种产物不是同一份数据换壳，而是各自按目标生态的写法生成；还附带无障碍评分，等于顺手体检了对方的对比度。
why_en: The 8 outputs aren't one dataset re-skinned — each follows its target ecosystem's conventions, and the WCAG score doubles as a.
limit_zh: 只能读公开可访问的页面，登录墙后、纯客户端渲染还没出 DOM 的站抓不全；产物是设计变量和配色排版，不含组件结构。
limit_en: Public pages only — login walls and client-rendered sites come back incomplete. Output is tokens, color and type, not component structure.
title_en: Pull a whole site's design language into 8 formats
